text:
I'll start with the parts that don't need root, then hand you one command for your own terminal.

**1. Check what's there and install the binary (I can run these now):**

```sh
tentmaker version --json; tentmaker status --json
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/baney75/tentmaker/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --no-setup
tentmaker version --json
```

Without root the installer puts the binary in `~/.local/bin`. If `tentmaker` isn't found afterwards, I'll use the full path the installer printed.

**2. Questions before setup:**

- **Exact repo name.** Is the Codeberg owner literally `me`, or is that a placeholder? I'll use the exact owner and name you give me.
- **Public or private?** If `me/notes` is public, tell me. Tentmaker only runs pushes to the default branch and same-repo pull requests from authors you list, and it never runs forks. But on a public repo, code merged from outside contributors would run on this Mac, so I won't pass `--allow-public` without your explicit yes.
- **Token on this Mac.** Storing a Codeberg token makes this Mac a broker: it downloads the source from Codeberg and hands jobs to any other device in your pool. Is that what you want?

**3. Make a token (you do this; paste it nowhere in this chat):**

On codeberg.org, go to user settings > Applications, create a token with scopes `write:repository` and `read:user`. Keep it open for the next step.

**4. Run setup in your own terminal.** I can't type your sudo password, so this has to be you:

```sh
sudo tentmaker setup --yes --json --forge forgejo --forge-url https://codeberg.org --repo me/notes --token-stdin
```

When it waits for the token, paste it, press Enter, then Ctrl-D. Codeberg runs as the Forgejo forge type, in checks mode, which posts commit statuses named `tentmaker/<job name>`. If you want the budget set now, add `--memory 4GiB --boost-memory 12GiB`. Otherwise the defaults apply (a quarter of RAM for everyday use, half on AC power).

Tell me when it finishes. Then I'll run `tentmaker doctor --json` and apply the fix for any problem it reports. You don't need to change any workflow files: checks mode reads the existing ones. To gate merges, make the `tentmaker/*` statuses required in Codeberg's branch protection, which is your call.
